description: Inputs passed to the Xerberus common-cause policy WASM at evaluation time

wallets.description: Wallet addresses (0x-prefixed) whose positions make up the book. Their venues above the $100 dust floor (largest 50) are compared; at least two are needed for a meaningful result.

chain.description: Optional chain identifier, echoed in the output. Xerberus only scores ethereum and no longer takes a chain argument.

relations.description: Optional dependency families to follow upstream. Defaults to every family except liquidity_venue and lp_constituent (DEX pools).

window.description: Optional Xerberus data-window timestamp (ISO-8601). Omit for the latest window. Pass the same value to every xerberus_* pack in a composite.
